project_type: Node.js Express app with Socket.IO real-time features, single-page HTML frontend
build_system: npm (no build step, just node server.js)
test_command: No test suite exists. Validate by checking syntax with node -c.
verification_instructions: 1. Run node -c server.js to verify no syntax errors. 2. Start server and check /api/rankings returns valid JSON with remarks fields that reference the person above.
snapshot_or_generated_files: AutoLead_Updated_v3.zip must be recreated at /projects/sandbox/Cluade/AutoLead_Updated_v2/AutoLead_Updated_v3.zip after changes
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22 available via nvm.
key_patterns: Single server.js file with all backend logic. HTML files are self-contained with inline CSS and JS. Rankings API at GET /api/rankings?period=daily|weekly|monthly returns array of {agentId, name, score, interested, followups, totalCalls, notInterested, profilePhoto, rank, remarks}. Agent photos served from /api/admin/agent-photo/:eid. Leaderboard in agent.html is inside #dialerScreen after stats-grid. In admin.html it is below the Disposition Stats panel near bottom.
directory_structure: Root has server.js, package.json, public/ (with admin/index.html, agent/index.html, index.html, logo.png), data/ (state.json), uploads/ (agent_photos/, lead_docs/)
